bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json,re,pathlib,os,sys
out={}
for group,chat in [('video',-1002373696859),('gay',-1003770334893)]:
 matches=[]
 for page in range(8):
  p=subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py','--chat-id',str(chat),'--page',str(page)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=125)
  if p.returncode:
   sys.exit(61 if group=='video' else 62)
  lines=[v.split('=',1)[1] for v in p.stdout.splitlines() if v.startswith('USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=')]
  if len(lines)!=1:sys.exit(63)
  data=json.loads(lines[0])
  for row in data['rows']:
   title=row.get('title','')
   if re.search(r'ビデオ.{0,3}(チャット|chat)|video.?chat|ビデチャ|ビデオ通話|VC専用',title,re.I):
    matches.append(row)
  if not data.get('has_more'):break
 if len(matches)!=1:sys.exit((70 if group=='video' else 80)+min(len(matches),9))
 out[group]=matches[0]
base=pathlib.Path('deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261123')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
target=base/'audited-chat-topics.json'
fd=os.open(target,os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_WRONLY,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False)
print('TWO_VIDEO_CHAT_TOPICS_AUDITED=PASS')
PY
